title: Tor amplitude over the base ring for a complex over a flat algebra
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that if the base ring maps flatly to another ring, then the tor amplitude of a complex of modules over the target, computed over the target, is also its tor amplitude over the base, and the proof is an 8-line argument identifying the two derived tensor products. It observes that a projective resolution of the complex over the target is at the same time a flat resolution over the base, so that the derived tensor product over the base against any module can be rewritten as the derived tensor product over the target against the base change of that module; the bound on the tor amplitude over the target then applies verbatim. The identification of the two derived tensor products is the whole content and it is displayed.
